title: helm(private): enhance values schema + templating + init-jobs to improve upgrade/rollback stability
author: Priya Singh
ci_checks: ci/helm-lint: failed (templating edge-case) - fixed and rerun -> passed
commits: feat(helm): values schema v5 - add encryption, nodeselector, tolerations, and optional initJob gating
fix(init): ensure initjob pre-upgrade hook uses ordered hook weight to run before canaries
test(helm): add e2e upgrade/rollback scenario to CI
docs: document migration path and rollback guidance
description: Context: private deployments have seen flaky upgrades when init jobs and templated resources were evaluated out of order, causing migration initjobs to race with canary replicas. This PR introduces a backwards-compatible values schema v5 with stricter validation, templating improvements to avoid empty objects in CRs, ordered pre-upgrade hooks and an optional initJob gating mechanism. Motivation: reduce failed/partial upgrades in on-prem environments and provide clear upgrade/rollback guidance for operators. Changes: 1) values.schema.json: expanded schema for encryption.kms, nodeSelector, tolerations, and added validation for initJobs.enabled and initJobs.strategy; 2) values.yaml: default values aligned to safer defaults (initJobs.enabled: true for minor upgrades, initJobs.strategy: sequential); 3) templates/initjobs.yaml: split init jobs into ordered hooks with helm hook weights and improved idempotency (check for marker configmap before running migrations); 4) templates/hooks/pre-upgrade-hook.yaml: added helm.sh/hook-weight annotations to guarantee ordering relative to canary rollout hooks; 5) templates/_helpers.tpl: new helper functions to render selectors only when values are present to avoid empty map emit; 6) docs/helm/private-upgrade.md: upgrade/rollback checklist and migration steps plus sample helm commands. Compatibility: default behavior is backward-compatible; cluster operators with custom values may need to add the new keys or enable initJobs.strategy explicitly. Testing: local lint and template generation, CI e2e upgrade tests covering 3->2 and 2->3 chart downgrades, manual verification on internal staging. Rollout plan: merge to main, cut 2.3.0, coordinate with SRE for gradual rollout to Dedicated and Private customers, monitor alerts for failed initjobs for 48h. Checklist: - [x] values schema bump and validation - [x] templating fixes applied - [x] hooks ordered and idempotent - [x] CI e2e tests added - [x] docs updated
